title: Keravnos clinch OPAP Basket League title
description: AEK Larnaca - Keravnos 77-84 Keravnos are crowned OPAP BL champions. They upset AEK Larnaca in the decisive fifth game of the championship series on the road. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning the initial quarter 23-17. But AEK Larnaca won second period 22-20. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Keravnos looked well-organized offensively handing out 26 assists. American players dominated the game. Point guard Shavar Reynolds Jr (188-1998, college: Monmouth, agency: Octagon Europe) orchestrated the victory by scoring 25 points, 5 rebounds and 7 assists. Center Travis Taylor (203-1990, college: Xavier, agency: Slash Sports) contributed with a double-double by scoring 19 points and 14 rebounds for the winners.
